text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Hello, Big Sis? Yeah, I'm completely back 
on my feet! It's all thanks to your 
recipe♪

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I'll drop by the club sometime to thank 
you properly— No, let me say it in person! 
You really helped me out so much...!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
—Just kidding. Honestly, I just wanted to 
see your face after so long. Hehe... I bet 
Big Sis saw right through me.
